title: Synthetic demo: Evaluating AI agents
channel: KBfromYT test fixtures (not a real video)

segments.text: Final answer correctness alone is insufficient for evaluating an agent.
Trajectory evaluation checks tool selection, tool arguments, and intermediate steps.
A judge should examine whether the selected tools support the requested task.
Production monitoring records latency, errors, token costs, and user feedback.
Offline benchmarks should be compared with production outcomes before changing the agent.
